values: 清除友军身上的部分负面效果并重新分配生命比例，并为友军提供持续衰减的最大生命值。
Rolan cleanses dispellable debuffs from allies, redistributes their HP percentage, and grants them a temporary max HP boost that gradually decays.
拔出石中剑，清除友军身上可驱散的负面效果并重新分配己方非召唤物角色的生命值至同一比例，随后使所有友军提高150%最大生命值并恢复-1000% − 80% ATK生命值。该技能提高的最大生命值会在后续12秒内逐渐衰减。释放该技能时，额外提高己方15%士气。

Rolan draws Excalibur, cleansing the dispellable debuffs from his allies and redistributing the HP of all non-summoned allies so they are at the same percentage. He then increases all allies' max HP by 150% and restores -1000% − 80% ATK HP. The max HP gained from this skill gradually decays over 12s. Casting this skill also grants Rolan's allies 15% Morale.
生命值恢复量提高至-1050% − 80% ATK。
生命值恢复量提高至-1100% − 80% ATK。
生命值恢复量提高至-1150% − 80% ATK。
生命值恢复量提高至-1200% − 80% ATK。
罗兰提高己方士气，并根据士气为己方提高攻击力。主动释放时进一步提高友军攻击力并使其进入霸体持续一定时间。
Rolan boosts Morale for the allied team, increasing all allies' ATK based on the current Morale. When used actively, this skill further increases allies' ATK and makes them unaffected for a duration.

罗兰亲临战场，战斗开始时立即激励己方，提高20%士气。己方每有20%士气，使所有友军提高攻击力，提高量相当于罗兰10% + 1%初始攻击力，最多拥有100%士气。战斗中，己方每次释放终极技能将提高10%士气。当非召唤物敌人/友军被击败时，己方提高/失去10%士气；若罗兰被击败，己方永久失去所有士气。
主动释放时，为累计输出最高的2名友军施加祝福，使其在接下来10秒内处于霸体状态，并提高相当于罗兰18% + 2%的攻击力。当己方士气不低于60%时，该技能使友军在祝福期间额外提高50点急速。

Passive. When a battle starts, Rolan inspires his allies, granting the allied team 20% Morale. For every 20% Morale the team has, all allies gain ATK equal to 10% + 1% of Rolan's initial ATK. The team's Morale is capped at 100%.
During combat, the allied team gains 10% Morale whenever an ally casts an Ultimate. Defeating a non-summoned enemy grants 10% Morale, while losing a non-summoned ally deducts the same amount. If Rolan is defeated, all Morale is permanently lost.
Active. Rolan blesses the 2 allies with the highest cumulative damage dealt, making them unaffected for 10s and increasing their ATK by 18% + 2% of Rolan's ATK. If the allied team has at least 60% Morale, the blessed allies also gain 50 Haste while the blessing is active.
祝福提供的攻击力增幅提高至罗兰攻击力的20% + 2%。
Increases the ATK bonus from the blessing to 20% + 2% of Rolan's ATK.
祝福提供的攻击力增幅提高至罗兰攻击力的22% + 2%。
Increases the ATK bonus from the blessing to 22% + 2% of Rolan's ATK.
祝福提供的攻击力增幅提高至罗兰攻击力的24% + 2%。
Increases the ATK bonus from the blessing to 24% + 2% of Rolan's ATK.
为一定范围内的友军恢复生命值并使其受到伤害降低一段时间，若士气值较高还会额外眩晕敌人。
Rolan heals allies in an area and temporarily reduces their damage taken. At high Morale, he also attacks and stuns enemies.
选择友方最密集的区域，使其周围1格范围内的友军恢复-240% − 30% ATK生命值，并在后续10秒内受到伤害降低36% + 3%；当己方士气不低于60%时，额外选择敌人最密集的区域作为目标，对其周围1格范围内的敌人造成240% + 30% ATK伤害，并使其眩晕3秒。

Rolan targets the area with the most allies, restoring -240% − 30% ATK HP to allies within 1 tile and reducing their damage taken by 36% + 3% for 10s. If the allied team has at least 60% Morale, Rolan also targets the area with the most enemies, dealing 240% + 30% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile and stunning them for 3s.
治疗量提高至-260% − 30% ATK，伤害量提高至260% + 30% ATK。
Increases the HP restored to -260% − 30% ATK and the damage dealt to 260% + 30% ATK.
治疗量提高至-280% − 30% ATK，伤害量提高至280% + 30% ATK。
Increases the HP restored to -280% − 30% ATK and the damage dealt to 280% + 30% ATK.
治疗量提高至-300% − 30% ATK，伤害量提高至300% + 30% ATK。
Increases the HP restored to -300% − 30% ATK and the damage dealt to 300% + 30% ATK.
战斗中提高治愈并降低受到伤害。
Increases Healing and reduces damage taken during battle.
自身提高9点治愈并且受到伤害降低9%，己方每有20%士气，自身额外提高3点治愈、受到伤害额外降低3%。
Increases Healing by 9 and reduces damage taken by 9%. For every 20% Morale the allied team has, Rolan gains an extra 3 Healing and further reduces his damage taken by 3%.
自身提高12点治愈并且受到伤害降低12%，己方每有20%士气，自身额外提高4点治愈、受到伤害额外降低4%。
Increases Healing by 12 and reduces damage taken by 12%. For every 20% Morale the allied team has, Rolan gains an extra 4 Healing and further reduces his damage taken by 4%.
自身提高15点治愈并且受到伤害降低15%，己方每有20%士气，自身额外提高5点治愈、受到伤害额外降低5%。
Increases Healing by 15 and reduces damage taken by 15%. For every 20% Morale the allied team has, Rolan gains an extra 5 Healing and further reduces his damage taken by 5%.
己方士气值达到一定阈值后，展开结界，使所有友军免疫属性降低效果，释放终极技能时会召唤光影额外释放对应技能。

Once the allied team's Morale reaches a certain level, Rolan creates a ward that makes all allies immune to stat reductions. Whenever an ally casts their Ultimate, a radiant clone is summoned to cast their Ultimate again.
己方士气达到100%后，展开耀光结界，释放终极技能时会召唤继承其80%基础属性的光影再次释放其终极技能。结界存在时，罗兰被击败前士气值不再降低。在挑战首领以外的模式中，结界中的友军还会免疫属性降低的效果。

Once the allied team's Morale reaches 100%, Rolan creates a radiant ward. When an ally casts their Ultimate, a radiant clone appears, inheriting 80% of that ally's basic stats and casting their Ultimate again. While the ward is active, Morale will not decrease unless Rolan is defeated. In non-Boss battles, allies inside the ward are immune to stat reductions.
光影继承的属性提高至90%。
The radiant clone now inherits 90% of the ally's basic stats.
光影继承的属性提高至100%。
The radiant clone now inherits 100% of the ally's basic stats.
耀光结界内的友军每秒恢复80% ATK生命值，所有敌人每秒失去40% ATK生命值
Allies within the radiant ward recover 80% ATK HP every second, while all enemies within it lose 40% ATK HP every second.
己方上阵多名同阵营角色时，战斗开始时额外提高士气。
When a battle starts, the allied team gains extra Morale when multiple deployed heroes belong to the same faction.
己方包含最多上阵英雄的阵营中每有1名英雄，战斗开始时额外提高6%士气，若该阵营为<sprite name="spui_common_human">耀光帝国或<sprite name="spui_common_god">半神阵营，其中每有1名英雄还会额外提高4%士气，并使罗兰和该阵营的英雄在战斗开始时提高20点穿透、受到伤害降低50%，持续8秒。

When a battle starts, the allied team gains an extra 6% Morale for each hero from the faction with the most deployed heroes. If that faction is the <sprite name="spui_common_human">Lightbearer Empire or the <sprite name="spui_common_god">Celestials, the Morale bonus increases by 4% per hero, and Rolan and heroes from that faction also gain 20 Penetration and take 50% less damage for 8s.
